# Gamma Studio

> Ambient UI gradients built from layered CSS blend modes. Browse 500+ patterns, customize layers, and export CSS.

Gamma Studio is an open-source gradient gallery and generator based on Aura by Cristian Olivera.

- Live site patterns: hover a card to preview, open the customizer to edit layers
- Categories: aura, mesh, nebula, prism, lattice, grain, glass, flux, aurora, noise, halo, dusk
- Export: CSS, Tailwind, CSS variables, CSS-in-JS, PNG, SVG, and an AI reconstruction prompt
- Sister project: Gamma UI (https://gammaui.com) — main site; this app: https://studio.gammaui.com

Source: based on https://github.com/CristianOlivera1/Aura (MIT)
